# Akeem Ganikale — Portfolio

> Portfolio of Akeem Ganikale, a Lagos-based computer engineer.

The live site is the source of truth: https://portfolio-sepia-three-81.vercel.app/

## Source repository

https://github.com/Ak-eem/portfolio

The live site remains the source of truth.

## Implementation

The portfolio is a framework-free static site with no build step, as documented in the README.

## Selected projects

The portfolio features case studies for Mira, Vanta, Sentinel, and MB Luxe. See the live site for the current project descriptions and links.

## Accessibility guidance

The repository includes an accessibility review checklist: https://github.com/Ak-eem/portfolio/blob/main/ACCESSIBILITY.md. It provides review steps and references; it does not claim that an accessibility audit or WCAG conformance review has been completed.

## About this index

This file is an optional, unofficial Markdown index for tools that consume `llms.txt`. It does not claim to be a web standard, and it does not replace the live portfolio.
